sessionNote: Most figures are from the 2025/2026 or 2026/2027 admission cycles. Always confirm on the school's official portal.

courses.name: Medicine and Surgery
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Medicine and Surgery is Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with English compulsory.

courses.name: Law
courses.rule: Candidates need English plus any three Arts or Social Science subjects.

courses.name: Nursing Science
courses.rule: UTME candidates for Nursing/Nursing Science require English plus Chemistry, Biology and Physics.

courses.name: Pharmacy
courses.rule: UTME candidates for Pharmacy require English plus Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

courses.name: Medical Laboratory Science
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

courses.name: Physiotherapy
courses.rule: UTME candidates for Physiotherapy require Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with English being compulsory.

courses.name: Dentistry
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Chemistry, Biology and one other science subject (often Physics, as required by many universities).

courses.name: Computer Science
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Mathematics and Physics, plus one subject from Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics or Geography.

courses.name: Accounting
courses.rule: Candidates need English, Mathematics, Economics plus any Social Science subject.

courses.name: Economics
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Economics, and Mathematics, plus one subject from Government, History, Geography, Literature in English, French, or CRS/IRS.

courses.name: Mass Communication
courses.rule: Candidates need English plus any three Arts and Social Science subjects.

courses.name: Business Administration
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Mathematics, Economics and any other Social Science subject.

courses.name: Political Science
courses.rule: Candidates must take English and Government or History, plus two other Social Sciences or Arts subjects.

courses.name: Civil Engineering
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Civil Engineering is English, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

courses.name: Electrical/Electronic Engineering
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Electrical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

courses.name: Mechanical Engineering
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Mechanical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

courses.name: Chemical Engineering
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Chemical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

courses.name: Petroleum Engineering
courses.rule: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Petroleum Engineering is English (compulsory), Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics.

courses.name: Architecture
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Physics, and Mathematics, plus one subject chosen from Chemistry, Geography, Fine Art, Biology, or Economics.

courses.name: Microbiology
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Biology, Chemistry and either Physics or Mathematics.

courses.name: Biochemistry
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Chemistry and Biology plus either Physics or Mathematics.

courses.name: English
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Literature in English, one other Arts subject and another Arts or Social Science subject.

courses.name: Software Engineering
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Mathematics and Economics, plus one of Chemistry, Physics, Biology or Geography.

courses.name: Cyber Security
courses.rule: Candidates must take English, Mathematics, Physics, and one of Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics or Geography.

f.text: UTME ÷ 8 (max 50) + O'level points for 5 relevant subjects, one sitting (A1=4.0, B2=3.6, B3=3.2, C4=2.8, C5=2.4, C6=2.0; max 20) + Post-UTME (max 30)
f.note: UNILAG's admission office lists the 2025/2026 assessment as JAMB 50%, O'level 20%, Post-UTME 30% (admissions.unilag.edu.ng, offline when we checked on 6 Oct 2026).
